phase: 6 - the first successful write to the phone's flash

evidence.kernel: mt6895-ufs-twoblock: zone write 608456 ocs=0 polls=39 restored=1
evidence.read_back: read independently through the block device after the write

blast_radius.note: relative to the zone start, so block 608456 and nothing else

root_cause.symptom: ocs=7, INVALID_PRD_TABLE, which looks like a scatter-gather problem
root_cause.actual: two direction fields were wrong in the WRITE(10) the contract builds

fields.meaning: CT_UFS (1<<28) plus DD_OUT (1<<25); 0x0a000000 carried 2<<25, which is data-in

root_cause.how_missed: the constants were written by hand instead of taken from the loader's own ufs.h, which has had UTRD_DD_OUT and UPIU_FLAG_WRITE all along

attempts_before_this: 749-a: physio handed the strategy a user address (kernel data abort)
749-b: a refused write poisoned the lease, so the guard refused ownership back and the phone needed a manual fastboot -- twice
749-c: the ioctl argument was encoded as 24 bytes when the struct is 32
